options.name: parents
options.description: Remove empty parents after the operand.
help_lines: -p, --parents                  remove empty parents, stopping at the first failure

options.name: ignore-fail-on-non-empty
options.description: Ignore failures caused only by nonempty directories.
help_lines: --ignore-fail-on-non-empty  suppress only failures attributable to nonemptiness
-I is a project short alias of --ignore-fail-on-non-empty, not a GNU option.

options.name: verbose
help_lines: -v, --verbose                  report each removal attempt before it runs
